messages:
Priya (CS): heads up — EvoBank legal just sent an urgent ask: they found CVE-2026-4821 reported in a transitive dependency we ship in the private agent build. They need SBOM, confirmation if their deployment is affected, and a remediation ETA for SOC2 evidence.
Sam (Sec Eng): can you paste the exact package/version they called out? I can triage quickly.
Priya (CS): message quoted: "org.libcrypt:fast-crypto 1.2.3 -> CVE-2026-4821 (crypto padding oracle)". Customer on Redwood Private in eu-west-1 with KMS-backed key.
Marco (SRE): quick look — fast-crypto@1.2.3 is pulled by secret-store@0.9. It's transitive in the private agent runtime image. Proof: `docker inspect` layered deps + `sbom.json` shows secret-store -> org.libcrypt.
Sam (Sec Eng): ok. CVE-2026-4821 is a crypto padding oracle — vendor released 1.2.4 with patch. Impact depends on how we use the lib. If our calls use authenticated AEAD modes then risk is low, but we need to confirm usage in secret-store.
Dinesh (Infra): on private deployments with KMS, the secret-store delegates encryption to platform KMS for long-term storage, but it still uses fast-crypto for local caching layers. That local cache is where exploit surface exists.
Eve (Compliance): EvoBank wants: 1) SBOM for agent image and build pipeline evidence, 2) timeline for patch/backport, 3) confirmation whether keys/materials were exposed, and 4) an audit log slice showing no misuse. We need a concise response they can include in their SOC2 auditor packet.
Sam (Sec Eng): triage plan: 1) reproduce call sites to confirm usage of vulnerable API (today), 2) build patched agent with fast-crypto@1.2.4 and run regression tests (within 24h), 3) produce SBOM update + signed artifact + audit log excerpt (48h), 4) push hotfix release to Private customers with CI rollout (72h) unless regression blocks.
Marco (SRE): running local grep for `fast-crypto.*Cipher` now. Also spinning a test CI job: `ci/agents/pipeline#3471` (deploy-bot will post status).
deploy-bot: CI job 3471 queued -> running tests (unit + e2e).
Sam (Sec Eng): mitigation options for customer in meantime: a) block outbound traffic from agent to reduce exploitability, b) rotate any keys used to encrypt local cache (we have KMS rotation playbook), c) disable local cache via env var `SECRET_STORE_CACHE=off` until patched.
Priya (CS): EvoBank asked whether KMS protects them — can we say KMS mitigates exposure? They need exact language for SOC2.
Eve (Compliance): wording: "Based on our current design, long-term secret encryption is performed by customer-managed KMS keys and is not affected by the library vulnerability. Local in-memory or on-disk caches that use library X may be impacted; we recommend rotating any keys used for caches and applying the vendor patch. We will provide SBOM and audit logs to support this assertion." (can refine).
Dinesh (Infra): CI tests passing on patched image locally. I can stage a private-only rollout tomorrow morning EU window.
Sam (Sec Eng): I'll prepare the SBOM slice and a short forensic note: call graph evidence + `grep` output showing whether vulnerable API paths are exercised. Also include logs showing no anomalous decrypt failures in the last 90 days.
Marco (SRE): deploy-bot: CI job 3471 succeeded. Build 2026.3.1-patch1 created and signed.
deploy-bot: Staged rollout to private cluster eu-west-1 scheduled for 2026-07-12T07:00Z.
Priya (CS): EvoBank wants an ETA for delivery of all evidence. Can we give a single date?
Sam (Sec Eng): target: SBOM + signed artifact + audit log slice + compliance wording by 2026-07-12 08:00Z UTC. Patch rollout staged same day 07:00Z. If anything blocks we'll escalate.
Priya (CS): sending that timeline to EvoBank now. I'll cc security. will update thread with their reply. :thumbsup:
Eve (Compliance): I'll draft a one-page SOC2-friendly statement and attach SBOM template.
Dinesh (Infra): I'll own the rollout and post runbook + post-mortem checklist once done.
Sam (Sec Eng): thumbs up. Thanks all — I'll post the call-graph snippets and grep proof here shortly.
Priya (CS): thanks team, EvoBank replied saying they appreciate the timeline and asked for the exact audit log query we used — I'll add to their ticket.
Sam (Sec Eng): query we used: `SELECT * FROM agent_audit WHERE action='decrypt' AND timestamp >= now()-interval '90 days' AND agent_version LIKE '2026.%'` — share as example.
Priya (CS): copied to customer. closing loop once they confirm.
